items.title: Know what’s blocking your pull request with the new Mergeability API
items.summary: Getting a pull request ready to merge can mean checking approvals, builds, tasks, and repository rules. For tools and AI assistants, bringing those details together takes extra work. Bitbucket Cloud’s new Mergeability API makes that easier. A single endpoint returns structured checks that help explain what’s preventing a pull request from being merged.
